info.title: Tableau External Client API
info.description: Loopback HTTP interface for reading and authoring the open Tableau Desktop document. Clients authenticate with the bearer token published in the per-user discovery file.

servers.description: The Tableau Desktop loopback origin. The bound port is published in the per-user discovery file.

post.description: Replaces a single dashboard with the submitted Tableau XML, leaving the workbook's other sheets intact. The payload is checked for well-formed XML only and is NOT validated against the schema; use POST /v0/workbook/document:validate for XSD validation. This apply is unconditional last-writer-wins: it performs no precondition/If-Match check and will overwrite a concurrent edit to the same sheet. A concurrent rename of the target sheet is rejected as a failed operation (Tableau error 0xC655862E).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. Structured extension members, such as tableauErrorCode, may appear as additional top-level fields.

ApiRoot.description: API versions and the resource link map.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed. The code field identifies the specific problem, such as a missing required header or an unreadable body.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token was missing or invalid. The response carries a WWW-Authenticate challenge.

Forbidden.description: The request origin was not permitted.

NotFound.description: The addressed resource does not exist. The code field distinguishes an unknown route from a valid resource with an unknown id.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but does not support this HTTP method.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state, such as an unsupported payload version.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request Content-Type is not accepted by this endpoint.

MisdirectedRequest.description: The request Host header was not a loopback address.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The External Client API is disabled or shutting down.

Accepted.description: The command did not settle within the synchronous window. The body is the pending operation; poll the Location URL until it reaches a terminal state.

Location.description: Relative URL of the operation to poll.
